ipo_timing.expected_window: 2027 was the CFO’s reported expectation in August; no firm listing date verified. In September, the CEO ruled out 2026 without committing to a 2027 listing.
ipo_timing.note: The earlier possibility of listing sooner than 2027 is superseded by Altman’s subsequent public remarks excluding 2026.

ceo_timing_statement.speaker: Sam Altman
ceo_timing_statement.summary: Altman said listing would wait until the business and company were ready, considering societal readiness for the technology and safety. He did not promise a listing in 2027.

underwriters.note: Reported banks working on preparation of the confidential filing, not verified lead underwriters or a finalized syndicate. CNBC attributed these roles to a person familiar; both banks declined comment.

timeline.event: Closed private funding round with $122B in committed capital at $852B post-money valuation.

Advisory federal jury found Musk’s lawsuit untimely under the statute of limitations. Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers adopted the finding and dismissed his claims. This is not a finding resolving the underlying allegations on their merits; Musk said he would appeal. Subsequent appellate status not established here.
CNBC reported preparations for a confidential filing with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley. This was a plan, not confirmation of submission.
OpenAI publicly announced it had recently submitted a confidential S-1 and had not decided listing timing. This date is the announcement date, not a verified submission date.

Bloomberg reported completion of a company-funded tender offer for roughly $7B of current and former employee shares at an $852B company valuation. Secondary liquidity, not proceeds of a new fundraising round. Exact closing date not disclosed in the accessible original.
CNBC reported CFO Sarah Friar told employees OpenAI would be public in 2027, potentially sooner if business continued to inflect; a reported expectation, not a fixed listing date.
Fortune published its September 11 interview: Altman ruled out a 2026 IPO, citing safety and readiness; no firm 2027 commitment.
